capital_df.head()

# Drop the 'group' and 'color' columns
capital_df = capital_df.drop(columns=['group', 'color'])

# Filter the data for the Younger Bronze Age (1100-500 BCE)

# Extract the 'ZMW' column for the Younger Bronze Age
z_mw_values = young_bronze_age_df['ZMW'].values

# Display the first few values of 'ZMW' for the Younger Bronze Age
z_mw_values[:5]

# Calculate the mean and standard deviation of 'ZMW' for the entire Younger Bronze Age period
mean_zmw = young_bronze_age_df['ZMW'].mean()
std_zmw = young_bronze_age_df['ZMW'].std()

# Extract the 'ZMW' value at the beginning of the Younger Bronze Age (1100 BCE)
z_mw_1100_bce = young_bronze_age_df[young_bronze_age_df['BCE'] == 1100]['ZMW'].values[0]

# Display the results
mean_zmw, std_zmw, z_mw_1100_bce
